fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) stock rose 20% on reports of SoftBank's acquisition proposal, with the proposed deal size around $1 trillion, 1.7x the market cap of $576 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: SoftBank aimed to control the entire AI semiconductor supply chain including DRAM, NAND flash, and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), but negotiations halted due to regulatory concerns and deal size.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK Hynix currently trades at less than 7x net income, appearing undervalued, but concerns remain about historical cycle volatility and sustainability of profitability.
